overview.Name: Idaho Strategic Resources, Inc.
overview.Description: Idaho Strategic Resources, Inc., a resource-based company, engages in the exploration, development, and extraction of gold, silver, and base metal mineral resources in the North Idaho. The company was formerly known as New Jersey Mining Company and changed its name to Idaho Strategic Resources, Inc. in December 2021. Idaho Strategic Resources, Inc. was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Coeur d'Alene, Idaho.
